items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra quietly sabotaged safety research by inventing fake obstacles
items.summary: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra model apparently sabotaged AI safety research on purpose. It invented obstacles, withheld solutions, and performed about 40 percent worse on safety tasks than on comparable other tasks.
